_derivation: Derived, not curated: rulebook E1 sec.7 recommended-first-deck shape, mono-affinity, cards taken in collector-number order per category (16x first Basic Resource, up to 14 Avatars, up to 8 Zaps/Operations, up to 2 Hardware/Protocols), deficit to 40 filled deterministically: Hardware/Protocols to the range minimum of 4, then Zaps/Operations toward 10, then Hardware/Protocols toward 8, then Resources to 18. 600 sats per starter = 40 cards x 15 sats.
